# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

The command is `preflight`. Project work follows `preflight <project> <action>`. Every other command is a word
that cannot be used as a project name. See [configuration](configuration.md) for the environment variables the
CLI reads.

## Commands

### preflight auth

```text
Usage: preflight auth [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage signed-in devices.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  devices  List the devices signed in to your account.
  revoke   Sign a device out.
```

#### preflight auth devices

```text
Usage: preflight auth devices [OPTIONS]

  List the devices signed in to your account.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

#### preflight auth revoke

```text
Usage: preflight auth revoke [OPTIONS] DEVICE_ID

  Sign a device out. Its token stops working at once.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight drill

```text
Usage: preflight drill [OPTIONS]

  Review today's due drills.

Options:
  --ai    Have AI grade typed answers. Asks before sending each one.
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight export

```text
Usage: preflight export [OPTIONS]

  Export all data as JSON, CSV (a zip of tables), or Markdown.

Options:
  --format [json|csv|md]
  --out FILE              Write to a file instead of stdout.
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight import

```text
Usage: preflight import [OPTIONS] PATH

  Backfill past failures from a JSON list or a CSV file.

  Columns: project, title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), and optionally what_happened, guessed_cause,
  root_cause, fix, prevention, category, severity, minutes_lost, guess_correct. Importing the same
  file again adds nothing.

Options:
  --create-projects / --no-create-projects
                                  Create projects that do not exist yet.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight login

```text
Usage: preflight login [OPTIONS]

  Sign this device in to the Preflight server.

Options:
  --password    Sign in with a hidden password prompt instead of the browser.
  --no-browser  Print the sign-in link without opening a browser.
  --help        Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight logout

```text
Usage: preflight logout [OPTIONS]

  Forget this device's token.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight new

```text
Usage: preflight new [OPTIONS] NAME

  Create a project.

Options:
  --idea TEXT
  --goals TEXT
  --requirements FILE
  --no-input
  --help               Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight report

```text
Usage: preflight report [OPTIONS]

  Show progress, or the weekly report.

Options:
  --week  Show the weekly report instead of overall progress.
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight rules

```text
Usage: preflight rules [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...

  Show repeated patterns, suggested rules, and active rules.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  approve  Turn a repeated pattern into an active rule.
  set      Change a rule's text or status, for example to retire it.
```

#### preflight rules approve

```text
Usage: preflight rules approve [OPTIONS] PATTERN_ID

  Turn a repeated pattern into an active rule. PATTERN_ID can be the first characters of the id.

Options:
  --text TEXT  Checklist text. Defaults to the suggested rule.
  --ai         Ask AI to draft the rule from this pattern's failures.
  --help       Show this message and exit.
```

#### preflight rules set

```text
Usage: preflight rules set [OPTIONS] RULE_ID

  Change a rule's text or status, for example to retire it.

Options:
  --status [active|working|needs revision|retired]
  --text TEXT
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight search

```text
Usage: preflight search [OPTIONS] QUERY

  Search failures across all projects.

Options:
  --project TEXT
  --help          Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight ui

```text
Usage: preflight ui [OPTIONS]

  Open the dashboard.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## Project actions

Run these as `preflight <project> <action>`.

### preflight &lt;project&gt; add-link

```text
Usage: preflight <project> add-link [OPTIONS] URL

  Save a link, and optionally capture a public page.

Options:
  --internal    A reference only. Never fetched.
  --capture     Capture a public page as a text snapshot.
  --note TEXT
  --title TEXT
  --sensitive   Never offer this link to AI.
  --no-input
  --help        Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; check

```text
Usage: preflight <project> check [OPTIONS] N {done|na|defer}

  Mark item <n> done, na (needs --reason) or defer (needs --reason and --until).

Options:
  --reason TEXT
  --until [%Y-%m-%d]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; checklist

```text
Usage: preflight <project> checklist [OPTIONS]

  Show the checklist and item statuses.

Options:
  --md    Print as Markdown to paste into project docs.
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; close

```text
Usage: preflight <project> close [OPTIONS]

  Run the retrospective and close the project.

Options:
  --summary TEXT  Retrospective summary. Prompted for when missing.
  --help          Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; fail

```text
Usage: preflight <project> fail [OPTIONS] TITLE

  Log a failure. Blank prompts can be skipped and filled in later.

Options:
  --what TEXT
  --guess TEXT
  --cause TEXT
  --fix TEXT
  --prevention TEXT
  --category [missed edge case|wrong assumption|misread requirement|knowledge gap|no verification|wrong approach|state or concurrency bug]
  --severity [low|medium|high]
  --minutes INTEGER
  --guess-correct / --guess-wrong
  --date [%Y-%m-%d]               Backfill an older failure.
  --no-input                      Log only what was given on the command line.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; links

```text
Usage: preflight <project> links [OPTIONS]

  List links and snapshots.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; predict

```text
Usage: preflight <project> predict [OPTIONS] HYPOTHESIS

  Record a hypothesis and your confidence before debugging.

Options:
  --evidence TEXT             What you will look at to check it.
  --confidence INTEGER RANGE  How sure you are, 0 to 100.  [0<=x<=100]
  --help                      Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; predictions

```text
Usage: preflight <project> predictions [OPTIONS]

  List predictions and their outcomes.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; refresh

```text
Usage: preflight <project> refresh [OPTIONS] LINK_ID

  Re-capture a public link. Old snapshots are kept.

Options:
  --no-input
  --help      Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; requirements

```text
Usage: preflight <project> requirements [OPTIONS]

  Add or edit requirements. Each changed save is a new version.

Options:
  --file FILE
  --text TEXT
  --help       Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; resolve

```text
Usage: preflight <project> resolve [OPTIONS] PREDICTION_ID {right|wrong}

  Close a prediction with what actually happened.

Options:
  --failure TEXT  The failure this prediction was about (id prefix).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; review

```text
Usage: preflight <project> review [OPTIONS]

  Run the AI review again, for example after requirements or links change.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; start

```text
Usage: preflight <project> start [OPTIONS]

  Review the plan, build the checklist, and pass the start gate.

Options:
  --override TEXT  Start anyway, recording this reason.
  --no-ai          Skip the AI review and use only history and rules.
  --review-again   Run a new AI review even if one exists for these requirements.
  --no-input       Skip the AI review and do not walk through required items.
  --help           Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; status

```text
Usage: preflight <project> status [OPTIONS]

  Show progress for the project.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### preflight &lt;project&gt; win

```text
Usage: preflight <project> win [OPTIONS] TEXT

  Log an achievement.

Options:
  --tag [used a rule|caught a risk early|other]
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```
